articles.summary: DineSafe participated and presented at the Agroknow Workshop, titled “Using AI to Enhance Food Safety and Prevent Food Fraud,” held during NAFS 2025 Conference Week on Wednesday, September 17, 2025. This half-day interactive workshop brought together food safety professionals to explore how artificial intelligence can transform food safety, prevent fraud, and streamline regulatory compliance.
articles.title: Dinesafe Presents at Agroknow Workshop on AI and Food Safety During NAFS 2025 Conference Week

articles.summary: DineSafe recently participated in The Rotten Apple webinar, “Early Outbreak Detection with Consumer Data,” held on September 11 at 5:00 p.m. CDT and hosted by Karen Constable.
articles.title: DineSafe Participates in The Rotten Apple Webinar on Early Outbreak Detection
